title: Membership in a language complement
statement: Let $L$ be a language of finite binary strings and let $z$ be a finite binary string. Then $z$ belongs to the complement of $L$ if and only if $z$ does not belong to $L$.
hypotheses_covered: $L$ is a language over the binary alphabet
